newsitem.title: USA: ICU Medical sets rights plan.
newsitem.headline: ICU Medical sets rights plan.

text.p: ICU Medical Inc Wednesday announced a stockholder rights plan to protect the company and stockholders against a hostile takeover.
Under the plan, one preferred share purchase right will be distributed for each share of common stock outstanding. Rights will be distributed on August 7 to stockholders of record on July 28.
The rights generally will be exercisable after a person or group acquires or offers to acquire 15 percent or more of ICU's common stock in a deal that is not approved by the company's board.
